Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Metallic Velvet Decorative Throw Pillow, Soft and Luxurious, 17" x 17", Silver
Colors: Silver
This pillow's subtle metallic sheen delivers a hint of luxe along with coziness. A distressed-look woven pattern on the front offers a vintage touch; the back is striated velvet. This versatile pillow will blend easily with other solids and patterns. 17" x 17" Front: 65% Polyester, 35% Metallic ; Back: 100% Polyester Polyester fiber-filled insert included Insert can be easily removed via a bottom zipper on the cover Wipe with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
